parent_package: C34 dynamic carry aggregation and three-carry compression
positive_result: A marked-generator-sensitive shifted Miller state M_S(P)=f_G(P+S)/f_G(S) is publicly evaluable by an O(log n) Miller chain.
main_boundary: All anti-rational shifts are explicit n-th-power line gauges of one base Miller potential, while the norm-one component collapses to a centered public Kummer coordinate.
finite_screens: 520 anti-rational twist shifts and 54192 shift-query values
zero low-order seven-location monomial survivors across all five frozen curves
dense univariate parity interpolation on each canonical toy Miller state
